scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: You are now a member of our select brethren. I can still remember when I first met you.
scripts.translation: 你已成為我們精英兄弟會的一員。我依然記得初次與你相遇的情景。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: Strive to live the way of the sword with honor...
scripts.translation: 以榮譽踐行劍之道...

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: Cheers to our new future...
scripts.translation: 為我們嶄新的未來乾杯...

scripts.text: There are many paths one can take in the world. Most people can see their path but don't really follow it...
scripts.translation: 世間有許多道路。大多數人能看見自己的路，卻未必真正去追隨它...

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: Anyway the drinks here are really good. Would you like to have one?
scripts.translation: 這裡的酒真的很不錯。你想來一杯嗎？

scripts.text: Sure, let's have a drink.
scripts.translation: 好啊，喝一杯吧

scripts.text: I refuse.
scripts.translation: 我拒絕

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: Are you sure? You don't know the true elegance of these drinks...
scripts.translation: 真的不喝？你還沒體會過這酒的美妙滋味呢...

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: You walk the way of sword too don't you? Then we can understand each other. Drinks taste better when it's with a fellow Swordman.
scripts.translation: 你也行走在劍之道上，對吧？那我們便能互相理解。與同為劍士的人一起喝酒，味道會更好。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: I'll buy this round.
scripts.translation: 這一輪我請客。

scripts.text: A toast to friendship~
scripts.translation: 為友誼乾杯~

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: In my opinion you seem to be ready to start a new way...
scripts.translation: 在我看來，你似乎已經準備好開啟新的道路了...

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: Walking the way of the sword is a perpetual battle. From now on you may have a rough journey ahead of you...
scripts.translation: 行走在劍之道上是一場永恆的戰役。從今往後，你的旅途或許會充滿艱辛...

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: If you want to walk on your new way and surpass your current limits, I'm willing to help you.
scripts.translation: 如果你想踏上新的道路並突破目前的極限，我願意幫助你。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: The true way of a Swordman who learned harmony to break the limit of a sword is a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 學會讓劍術與魔法相融，突破劍的極限，這便是盧恩騎士之道。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: Won't you join our brethren? You look like you're fully qualified to become one of us.
scripts.translation: 你願意加入我們的兄弟會嗎？你看起來完全有資格成為我們的一員。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: If you are interested, I'll introduce you to the masters who will guide you to the way of the Rune Knight with my recommendation.
scripts.translation: 有興趣的話，我可以推薦你去見幾位導師。他們會指引你踏上盧恩騎士之道。

scripts.text: I am not ready yet.
scripts.translation: 我還沒準備好

scripts.text: I'm ready to be a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 我準備好成為盧恩騎士了

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: Right. Every challenge always needs preparation. Okay, I'll wait for you.
scripts.translation: 沒錯。每一次挑戰都需要充分的準備。好吧，我會等你。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: Of course, I would only accept you if you are one hundred percent sure of your conviction to become a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 當然，只有當你百分之百確信自己立志成為盧恩騎士時，我才會接納你。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: You're sure now?
scripts.translation: 下定決心了

scripts.text: Let me send a dispatch to my comrades that you are willing to join our ranks.
scripts.translation: 嗎？我這就傳信給同伴，告訴他們你願意加入。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: You know the place called Glast Heim? There's a Rune Knight waiting for you there, he will guide you to the entrance of Glast Heim Tower.
scripts.translation: 你知道葛拉斯特海姆這個地方嗎？那裡有一位盧恩騎士在等你，他會指引你前往葛拉斯特海姆之塔的入口。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: My name is Manuel. I am called the Rune Knight of Brilliance. When you tell him that you are a Rune Knight candidate with my recommendation, he will handle the rest.
scripts.translation: 我叫曼努埃爾，人稱光輝的盧恩騎士。告訴他，你是經我推薦的候選人，剩下的事他會安排。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: I will wait for the day that you become our comrade as a true Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 我會等待你成為真正的盧恩騎士，成為我們同伴的那一天。

scripts.text: If you continually walk the way of the sword, you will eventually feel the limits of your powers. Like myself before...
scripts.translation: 如果你一直行走在劍之道上，終有一天你會感到力量的極限。就像以前的我一樣...

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: When the time comes there will be a way to help you surpass that limit. Until the day that your strength has grown comes, we can at least still have a drink together.
scripts.translation: 到時候，會有辦法幫助你突破那個極限。在力量增長的那一天到來之前，我們至少還可以一起喝一杯。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: A toast to the day that your strength can withstand the powers of a Rune Knight!
scripts.translation: 為有朝一日，你能擁有足以駕馭盧恩騎士之力的實力，乾杯！

scripts.text: I believe that the wind of change is not always a good one.
scripts.translation: 我相信，變革之風並不總是美好的。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: Just like the taste of this drink. I wish the taste of this drink is kept here forever.
scripts.translation: 就像這酒的味道一樣。我希望這酒的味道能永遠留在這裡。

scripts.text: The Rune Knight is waiting for you at Glast Heim. He will guide you to the entrance of Glast Heim Tower.
scripts.translation: 盧恩騎士正在葛拉斯特海姆等你。他會指引你前往葛拉斯特海姆之塔的入口。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: Tell him that you are a candidate to be a Rune Knight and he will handle the rest.
scripts.translation: 告訴他你是盧恩騎士的候選人，剩下的事就交給他了。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: I will wait for the day you become our comrade as a true Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 我會等待你成為真正的盧恩騎士，成為我們同伴的那一天。

scripts.text: Don't you have things to do right now?
scripts.translation: 你現在不是還有事要忙嗎？

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Manuel]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 曼努埃爾]

scripts.text: No? Well then never mind.
scripts.translation: 不嗎？那就算了。

scripts.text: Don't you love the smell of alcohol?
scripts.translation: 你不喜歡酒的味道嗎？

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: Oh, you must be {0}.
scripts.translation: 哦，你就是吧。 {0}

scripts.text: Welcome.
scripts.translation: 歡迎。

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: We are looking forward to you helping the Rune Knights spread honor throughout the world.
scripts.translation: 我們期待你能協助盧恩騎士，將榮耀傳遍整個世界。

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: So, What can I help you with?
scripts.translation: 那麼，有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: I want to go to the gathering place.
scripts.translation: 我想去集會地點

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: Right. I'll send you right now. I'll see you soon.
scripts.translation: 好的。我現在就送你過去。回頭見。

scripts.text: I am the only knight who's keeping the way of the Swordsman in this cursed place Glast Heim.
scripts.translation: 我是這個被詛咒的地方——葛拉斯特海姆中，唯一堅守劍士之道的騎士。

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: Since you don't walk the way of the Sword, you wouldn't understand our spirit. I can manage by myself. Follow your own path.
scripts.translation: 既然你不走劍之道，就無法理解我們的精神。我自己能應付。請走你自己的路。

scripts.text: Are you a cursed ghost of this place? Or are you an ignorant adventurer?
scripts.translation: 你是這個地方的詛咒幽靈？還是一個無知的冒險者？

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: If you are a breathing human, then listen to me carefully. I wouldn't risk my life here by hesitating to talk to just anyone.
scripts.translation: 如果你是一個有呼吸的人類，那就仔細聽我說。我不會因為猶豫是否要和陌生人交談而在這裡冒生命危險。

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: I am the only knight who's keeping the way of the Swordsman in this cursed place Glast Heim.
scripts.translation: 我是這個被詛咒的地方——葛拉斯特海姆中，唯一堅守劍士之道的騎士。

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: If you also follow the way of the Swordsman our paths will most certainly cross again when you have reached your full potential.
scripts.translation: 如果你也遵循劍士之道，當你發揮全部潛力時，我們的道路一定會再次交匯。

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: I am a man walking the way of the Sword. But I'm not exactly the same as the likes of you, Rune-Midgarts knight.
scripts.translation: 我是一個行走於劍之道的男子。但我並不像你們盧恩·米德加茲的騎士那樣。

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: We are not like the other Knights who are absorbed with pomp and circumstance so you may not know of us yet.
scripts.translation: 我們不同於那些沉迷於排場和儀式的其他騎士，所以你可能還不太瞭解我們。

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: We are the Rune Knights. A group that leads the true power as well as the physical strength to the righteous way of the Sword.
scripts.translation: 我們是盧恩騎士，將真正的力量與強健的體魄融為一體，踐行劍之正道。

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: We have been living in secret here in the deep of Glast Heim for a half century but it's time to let the world know our purpose.
scripts.translation: 我們在葛拉斯特海姆深處秘密生活了半個世紀，但現在是讓世界知道我們目的的時候了。

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: Now there are many instructors who are looking for talented Sword wielders in various places of Rune-Midgarts. They are looking for a people who will join the true way of the Sword.
scripts.translation: 現在，盧恩·米德加茲各地有許多導師正在尋找有天賦的劍士。他們在尋找願意加入劍之正道的人。

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: If you wish to join the Rune Knights. Please get a recommendation from one of the guides and come to me again.
scripts.translation: 如果你想加入盧恩騎士，請從其中一位嚮導那裡獲得推薦，然後再來找我。

scripts.text: I came to be a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 我想成為盧恩騎士

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: Um... Are you the Rune Knight candidate that Manuel talked about?
scripts.translation: 嗯...你是曼努埃爾提到的那位盧恩騎士候選人嗎？

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: Your name is {0}, right? I can see clearly that you are qualified to become our comrade.
scripts.translation: 你叫，對吧？看得出，你有資格成為我們的同伴。 {0}

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: Good. I don't have to ask any more about your qualification to join our brethren....1.S... Now I'll give you your first assignment.
scripts.translation: 很好。我不必再詢問你加入我們兄弟會的資格了...現在，我將給你第一個任務。

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: Find our Rune Knight gathering place hidden inside of Glast Heim.
scripts.translation: 找出隱藏在葛拉斯特海姆內部的盧恩騎士集會地點。

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: There's a place that leads to the Rune Knight's secret gathering room inside the Glast Heim Chivalry. Find that place by yourself.
scripts.translation: 在葛拉斯特海姆騎士團內部，有一個通往盧恩騎士秘密集會室的地方。請你自己找到那裡。

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: If you can find it, there'll be a person waiting to greet you, so let's start.
scripts.translation: 如果你能找到那裡，會有人等著迎接你。那麼，開始吧。

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: Of course your life might be at risk by the ghosts of Glast Heim... but overcoming the risk shouldn't be hard for a Rune Knight candidate.
scripts.translation: 當然，葛拉斯特海姆的幽靈可能會威脅到你的生命...但對於一名盧恩騎士候選人來說，克服這種風險應該不難。

scripts.text: The 1st assignment is to find out our Rune Knight gathering place hidden inside of Glast Heim.
scripts.translation: 第一個任務是找出隱藏在葛拉斯特海姆內部的盧恩騎士集會地點。

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: There's a place that leads to the Rune Knights' secret gathering place inside Glast Heim Chivalry. Find that place by yourself.
scripts.translation: 在葛拉斯特海姆騎士團內部，有一個通往盧恩騎士秘密集會室的地方。請你自己找到那裡。

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: If you can find it, there'll be a person waiting to greet you, so let's start.
scripts.translation: 如果你能找到那裡，會有人等著迎接你。那麼，開始吧。

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: Of course your life might be at risk by the ghosts of Glast Heim... but overcoming the risk shouldn't be hard for a Rune Knight candidate.
scripts.translation: 當然，葛拉斯特海姆的幽靈可能會威脅到你的生命...但對於一名盧恩騎士候選人來說，克服這種風險應該不難。

scripts.text: It seems that you are still taking the test. Do your best and pass all the tests.
scripts.translation: 看來你還在接受測試。加油，通過所有的測試。

scripts.text: I want to go to the gathering place.
scripts.translation: 我想去集會地點

scripts.text: Quit the conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: [Rune Leader Jungberg]
scripts.translation: [盧恩首領 榮格伯格]

scripts.text: All right. I'll send you right away. I'll check you later.
scripts.translation: 好的。我馬上送你過去。之後我會再檢查你的情況。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Staff]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士團職員]

scripts.text: Welcome, {0}. Are you going to the gathering place?
scripts.translation: 歡迎，。你是要去集會地點嗎？ {0}

scripts.text: Yes, take me there.
scripts.translation: 是的，帶我去吧

scripts.text: I'm on other business.
scripts.translation: 我有其他事要辦

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Staff]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士團職員]

scripts.text: Okay, come in. I'll guide you.
scripts.translation: 好的，請進。我會指引你。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Staff]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士團職員]

scripts.text: Oh, really? Then, keep on your work. I'll continue with my mission.
scripts.translation: 哦，是嗎？那你繼續你的工作吧。我也要繼續執行我的任務了。

scripts.text: Ah... this area is off limits, you are prohibited to be here. Please do not do anything to hinder our efforts.
scripts.translation: 啊...這個區域是禁區，禁止你在此逗留。請不要做任何阻礙我們行動的事情。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Staff]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士團職員]

scripts.text: Although... you seem to have the potential to become a companion to those who follow the path of the sword.
scripts.translation: 不過...你似乎有潛力成為那些追隨劍道之人的同伴。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Staff]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士團職員]

scripts.text: I'm sure we'll be crossing paths before long. I believe we will meet again.
scripts.translation: 相信我們很快就會再見。

scripts.text: You found this place correctly. Jungberg sent me to send you to the gathering place.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，就是這裡。榮格伯格派我在此等候，送你去集會地點。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Staff]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士團職員]

scripts.text: When you get into the gathering place, talk to Captain Tigris. He's always waiting for new members to show up.
scripts.translation: 到了集會地點，先去找提格里斯隊長。他一直盼著新成員到來。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Staff]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士團職員]

scripts.text: Well, please follow me.
scripts.translation: 那麼，請跟我來。

scripts.text: Wait! This place is prohibited. I don't mind you wandering about but, don't ever disturb me again.
scripts.translation: 站住！這裡是禁區。我不介意你四處遊蕩，但請不要再打擾我了。

scripts.text: You've got too many things. You cannot proceed anymore. Please try again after losing some weight.
scripts.translation: 你攜帶的物品太多了，無法繼續前進。請減輕負重後再試。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Oh, I see... Please wait a moment.
scripts.translation: 哦，我明白了...請稍等片刻。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: I forgot to check if you are qualified to get the celebration gift for changing your job...
scripts.translation: 我忘了確認你是否符合領取轉職慶典禮物的資格...

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Let me check the report from the instructors who took care of your tests.
scripts.translation: 讓我檢視一下負責你測試的教官提交的報告。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Hm... This is perfect. You've come here with very rare good records.
scripts.translation: 嗯...完美。能取得這麼優秀成績的候選人，可真不多見。

scripts.text: Hmm... This is great. You've come here with decent records.
scripts.translation: 嗯...不錯，你的成績很好。

scripts.text: Hmm, not bad. It's not a great record but you tried your best.
scripts.translation: 嗯，還不錯。成績雖算不上優異，但你已經盡力了。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Here, take this. It's a gift that I like to give to the younger generation like yourself.
scripts.translation: 來，收下吧。這是我送給你們這些後輩的一點心意。

scripts.text: Hey, long time no see, {0}. I don't think you've got any important matters to discuss but make yourself comfortable.
scripts.translation: 嘿，好久不見，。我想你應該沒有什麼重要的事情要談吧，那就請自便吧。 {0}

scripts.text: A man wearing glorious armor and passion in his eyes is standing in front of me.
scripts.translation: 一位身穿輝煌鎧甲、眼中充滿熱情的男子正站在我面前。

scripts.text: He stares at me with an absent look and after a while he begins to talk.
scripts.translation: 他目光空洞地看著我，過了一會兒，他開始說話了。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Hey, are you the Rune Knight candidate that Manuel recommended? I am Captain Tigris from the Rune Knights, and your name is?
scripts.translation: 你就是曼努埃爾推薦的盧恩騎士候選人吧？我是盧恩騎士團的隊長提格里斯，你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Oh, I've heard it before but I've forgotten it. Right, were you {0}? I truly welcome you from the heart for coming here.
scripts.translation: 哦，我好像聽過這個名字，但忘了。對了，你是吧？我發自內心地歡迎你來到這裡。 {0}

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Let's see. How many candidates have come to this room? Hey, Lunarea, which candidate is this one here?
scripts.translation: 讓我想想，到這間屋子的候選人有多少了？露娜蕾雅，這位是第幾個？

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: She says so my friend. Actually I don't want to see the next one. So please do well.
scripts.translation: 聽見了吧，朋友。說實話，我可不想再等下一位了，你要好好表現啊。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Let me see... Manual and Jungberg must have finished the basic verification, then let's start the test right away.
scripts.translation: 嗯...曼努埃爾和榮格伯格應該已經稽核過你的基本資格，那就直接開始測試吧。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Lunarea, proceed with the first test.
scripts.translation: 露娜蕾雅，開始第一項測試。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: This pale-skinned female Rune Knight called Lunarea is nodding her head quietly and watching me.
scripts.translation: 這位皮膚白皙的盧恩騎士露娜蕾雅靜靜地點了點頭，注視著我。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: The test begins now. First, you'll get the 1st test from that beautiful icy lady, so please try your best.
scripts.translation: 測試現在開始。首先，你要接受那位美麗而冷峻的女士的第一項測試，請全力以赴。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: When the test is done, talk to me. Anyway you'll need to care about the tests progressing with other people.
scripts.translation: 測試結束後，來找我。總之，你需要留意其他候選人的測試進度。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Well then, I'll be waiting here so take the test.
scripts.translation: 那麼，我就在這裡等著，去接受測試吧。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Now the test begins. First, you'll get the 1st test from that beautiful icy lady, so please try your best.
scripts.translation: 測試現在開始。首先，你要接受那位美麗而冷峻的女士的第一項測試，請全力以赴。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: When the test is done, talk to me... anyway you'll need to care about the tests progressing with other people.
scripts.translation: 測試結束後，來找我...總之，你需要留意其他候選人的測試進度。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Well then, I'll be waiting here so take the test.
scripts.translation: 那麼，我就在這裡等著，去接受測試吧。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Hey you, weren't you testing? Lunarea, what happened? Is the test all done?
scripts.translation: 喂，你不是在測試嗎？露娜蕾雅，發生什麼事了？測試都結束了嗎？

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: She just shakes her head without saying any word, and stares at me. She has piercing eyes.
scripts.translation: 她一言不發地搖了搖頭，盯著我看。她的眼神銳利。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Okay Lunarea. Hey, listen to me carefully. Lunarea is a poor talker and quiet but you shouldn't ignore her.
scripts.translation: 好啦，露娜蕾雅。喂，你聽好了，她不善言辭，平時話很少，可別因此怠慢她。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Even for me... no, any one of us who upsets her wouldn't be able to deal with that.
scripts.translation: 就連我...不，我們這裡誰惹她生氣，都吃不了兜著走。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Whoa don't look at me like that. Okay, you see that? Aspiring Rune Knight. Go back to Lunarea and take the test as she says. That'll be good for you.
scripts.translation: 哎喲，別這麼看著我。這位候選人，看見了吧？乖乖回去，照露娜蕾雅說的接受測試，對你有好處。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Umm, it seems that you've passed Lunarea's test? I guess I won't have to test more for the basics.
scripts.translation: 嗯，看來你已經通過了露娜蕾雅的測試？我想我不必再進行基礎測試了。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Undeniably our Rune Knights have some differences but we should not forget our Swordsman roots.
scripts.translation: 我們盧恩騎士固然與其他騎士不同，但也不能忘了自己身為劍士的根本。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: From now on, this will be the real test as a Rune Knight that you want to be. You'll need to prepare to take next test.
scripts.translation: 從現在開始，這才是你作為盧恩騎士的真正考驗。你需要為下一項測試做好準備。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Renoa, I know that you've been waiting for a long time but it's your turn.
scripts.translation: 雷諾阿，讓你久等了，這回輪到你了。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: It really has been such a long time but Lunarea's test and mine differ like the sky to the earth. I hope you won't be just a muscle-headed fool.
scripts.translation: 確實等了很久，但露娜蕾雅的測試和我的測試天差地別。希望你不要只是個四肢發達的傻瓜。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Hahaha. you heard that? It won't be easy this time. I hope you get through it my friend.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，你聽到了嗎？這次可不容易。我希望你能順利通過，我的朋友。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Go to that fiery lady in the library room to get the next test done and come back.
scripts.translation: 去藏書室找那位脾氣火爆的女士，完成下一項測試再回來。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Now, this will be the real test as a Rune Knight. You've got to prepare to take the next test.
scripts.translation: 現在，這才是作為盧恩騎士的真正考驗。你需要為下一項測試做好準備。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Renoa, I know that you've been waiting for a long time but it's your turn.
scripts.translation: 雷諾阿，讓你久等了，這回輪到你了。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: It really has been such a long time but Lunarea's test and mine differ like the sky to the earth. I hope you won't be just a muscle-headed fool.
scripts.translation: 確實等了很久，但露娜蕾雅的測試和我的測試天差地別。希望你不要只是個四肢發達的傻瓜。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Hahaha. you heard that? It won't be easy this time. I hope you get through it my friend.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，你聽到了嗎？這次可不容易。我希望你能順利通過，我的朋友。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Go to that fiery lady in the library room to get the next test done and come back.
scripts.translation: 去藏書室找那位脾氣火爆的女士，完成下一項測試再回來。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Oh, I heard that you've passed Renoa's test which only few people could pass.
scripts.translation: 哦，我聽說你通過了雷諾阿的測試，那可是隻有少數人能通過的。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: I heard that the number of candidates who've given up while taking Renoa's test has been high.
scripts.translation: 我聽說在參加雷諾阿測試的候選人中，放棄的人數相當多。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: You have to understand. I think it was the test that shows exactly the test instructor's personality. Hmm...
scripts.translation: 你要明白。我覺得那項測試完全體現了考試指導員的個性。嗯...

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Now, there's only the last test left. When you pass this, you will be on your way to officially becoming a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 現在只剩下最後一項測試了。通過這項測試，你就正式踏上成為盧恩騎士的道路了。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Take the final test from the Rune Knight Velpino who is at the arsenal's right side.
scripts.translation: 去軍械庫右側找盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾接受最終測試。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: I'm not kidding, I am really looking forward to your new start as a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 我沒開玩笑，我真的非常期待你作為盧恩騎士的新起點。

scripts.text: So please do your best.
scripts.translation: 所以請全力以赴。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Take the final test from the Rune Knight Velpino who is at the arsenal's right side.
scripts.translation: 去軍械庫右側找盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾接受最終測試。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: I'm not kidding, I am really looking forward to your new start as a Rune Knight. So please do your best.
scripts.translation: 我沒開玩笑，我真的非常期待你作為盧恩騎士的新起點。所以請全力以赴。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Congratulations. Now you've passed all the tests and can walk the way of a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 恭喜。現在你已經通過了所有測試，可以踏上盧恩騎士的道路了。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: I'm happy from the bottom of my heart. I'm very proud of you.
scripts.translation: 我從心底感到高興。我為你感到驕傲。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Now you can be yourself around us and stand proud as one of us.
scripts.translation: 從今往後，不必再拘束了。你可以昂首挺胸，作為我們的一員站在這裡。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: There's the evaluations from Lunarea, Renoa and Velpino who took care of your tests.
scripts.translation: 這裡有露娜蕾雅、雷諾阿和維爾皮諾對你測試的評價。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: It's not much but there are some gifts for new Rune Knights who got good scores on the tests.
scripts.translation: 雖然不多，但這是給在測試中取得好成績的新盧恩騎士的禮物。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: There will be a difference depending on the scores, but they are all helpful for anyone who is a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 根據分數不同會有所區別，但它們對任何盧恩騎士都有幫助。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Lastly, there are several things to be aware of as a Knight who's experienced a job change to a Lord Knight in Valhalla.
scripts.translation: 最後，對於在英靈殿重生、轉職為騎士領主的騎士，還有幾件事需要注意。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Well, my job is done now. Would you like to start your new life as a Rune Knight?
scripts.translation: 好了，我的任務完成了。你想開始你作為盧恩騎士的新生活嗎？

scripts.text: Every preparation is done.
scripts.translation: 一切準備就緒

scripts.text: I need more time to think.
scripts.translation: 我需要更多時間考慮

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Weren't you listening?
scripts.translation: 你剛才沒在聽嗎？

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: If you understood, then make your preparations and come back.
scripts.translation: 如果你明白了，那就做好準備後再回來吧。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: It seems not enough?
scripts.translation: 看來還不夠呢？

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Please unequip your mount and come back again.
scripts.translation: 請先解除騎乘狀態，再回來。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Our Master, Beljeve... and the Great Sage, Serpeone...
scripts.translation: 我們的師父貝爾傑夫...以及大賢者塞爾佩奧內...

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: This Knight is going to walk the way of the Rune Knights with us, so please give your blessing.
scripts.translation: 這位騎士將與我們一同踏上盧恩騎士的道路，請賜予祝福。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Congratulations.
scripts.translation: 恭喜。你

scripts.text: You are now an honorable Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 現在是一位光榮的盧恩騎

scripts.text: Remember this day from this day forth!
scripts.translation: 士了。請銘記這一天！

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: There's a royal gift from the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom for all new Rune Knights.
scripts.translation: 盧恩·米德加茲王國為所有新晉盧恩騎士準備了王室禮物。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Give me a second to get the royal gift and talk to me again.
scripts.translation: 請稍等，我去取王室禮物，然後再來找我。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: I don't know how you were able to get here. But it looks like you've come to a place where you shouldn't be.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你是怎麼來到這裡的。但看起來你來到了不該來的地方。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Go back to where you belong.
scripts.translation: 回到你該去的地方吧。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: If there's any equipment that you are wearing now, or anything you're holding. Please empty it for your job change moment.
scripts.translation: 轉職前，請卸下所有裝備，並清空攜帶的物品。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Talk to the Kafra Employee to use the storage.
scripts.translation: 去找卡普拉職員使用倉庫。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: You might know already, if you are riding a Peco Peco, you should have left it behind. If you brought it, leave it and come again.
scripts.translation: 你應該知道，轉職前要先解除大嘴鳥騎乘狀態。若還騎著，就先解除再來。

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: One more thing. If you have any remaining skill-points, use it all and learn the skills. You won't be able to change jobs if you have any more skill points.
scripts.translation: 還有一件事。如果你還有剩餘的技能點，請全部用完並學習技能。如果還有剩餘技能點，將無法轉職。

scripts.text: She holds up her chin quietly, nods lightly and notices me.
scripts.translation: 她靜靜地抬起下巴，輕輕點了點頭，注意到了我。

scripts.text: Then after a moment she puts her face down and seems absorbed with other thoughts.
scripts.translation: 過了一會兒，她低下頭，似乎陷入了沉思。

scripts.text: She finally opens her mouth and begins to talk.
scripts.translation: 她終於開口說話了。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: 5 minutes... When you endure and get rid of all, you succeed.
scripts.translation: 5分鐘...撐住，消滅所有敵人，就算通過。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: In this test, Captain Tigris, Renoa, Velpino and I will visit together.
scripts.translation: 測試時，提格里斯隊長、雷諾阿、維爾皮諾和我都會到場。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: If you want to, you can ask help from one of us. But don't think that we will always help.
scripts.translation: 如果你願意，可以向我們其中一人求助。但不要以為我們會一直幫助你。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: Since it's a test, getting help from us is completely your choice. It doesn't matter if you take the test with our help or all by yourself.
scripts.translation: 既然是考驗，是否接受我們的幫助完全由你決定。無論是有我們的協助還是獨自完成，都沒有關係。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: When you are ready to go to the test field talk to me.
scripts.translation: 當你準備好前往考驗場地時，請與我對話。

scripts.text: Move to the test field now.
scripts.translation: 現在前往考驗場地

scripts.text: Give me time to get ready.
scripts.translation: 給我一點準備時間

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: Did you fail? But, there's no limitation to the number of times you can try.
scripts.translation: 你失敗了嗎？不過，嘗試的次數是沒有限制的。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: If you want to take the test again. I can send you to the test field.
scripts.translation: 如果你想再次接受考驗，我可以將你傳送到考驗場地。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: 5 minutes... When you endure and get rid of all, you succeed.
scripts.translation: 5分鐘...撐住，消滅所有敵人，就算通過。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: If you are ready to move to the test field talk to me.
scripts.translation: 當你準備好前往考驗場地時，請與我對話。

scripts.text: Move to the test field now.
scripts.translation: 現在前往考驗場地

scripts.text: Please give me time to prepare.
scripts.translation: 請給我一點準備時間

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: Once someone enters into the test field you cannot enter directly. The test is taken one by one.
scripts.translation: 一旦有人進入考驗場地，其他人就不能直接進入。考驗必須逐一進行。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: When it's your turn to enter you will be sent there directly.
scripts.translation: 輪到你的時候，你會被直接傳送過去。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: Was your test successful?
scripts.translation: 你的考驗成功了嗎？

scripts.text: She shows a small smile which is barely visible and looks at me.
scripts.translation: 她露出一絲幾乎看不見的微笑，看著我。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: This portion of the test is over. Go talk to Captain Tigris.
scripts.translation: 這一部分的考驗結束了。去和隊長 提格里斯談談吧。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: This portion of the test is over. Go talk to Captain Tigris.
scripts.translation: 這一部分的考驗結束了。去和隊長 提格里斯談談吧。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: There are other tests you need to complete. I hope you do a good job.
scripts.translation: 還有其他考驗需要你完成。希望你能表現良好。

scripts.text: This pale-skinned absent-looking female Rune Knight doesn't seem to care. Of course she doesn't seem interested with my existence
scripts.translation: 這位膚色蒼白、神情恍惚的女性盧恩騎士似乎毫不在意。當然，她看起來對我的存在毫無興趣。

scripts.text: She nods her head and reaches out her hand lightly. Then she draws her sword and makes a signal.
scripts.translation: 她點了點頭，輕輕伸出手。隨後她拔出劍，做了一個手勢。

scripts.text: But her expression suddenly changed a bit as she looked at to speak.
scripts.translation: 但當她看向我、準備開口時，表情突然微微變了。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: Now... the testing room is currently occupied...
scripts.translation: 現在...考驗室正被佔用...

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: You'll have to wait... it is regulation that the test must take place one by one.
scripts.translation: 你得等等...規定考驗必須逐一進行。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Lunarea]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 露娜蕾雅]

scripts.text: Just wait 5 minutes and it should be your turn.
scripts.translation: 只需等待5分鐘，應該就輪到你了。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Congratulations for becoming one of us. Junior Rune Knight, {0}.
scripts.translation: 恭喜你加入我們，後輩盧恩騎士。 {0}

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Soon you'll see the way we need to go clearly.
scripts.translation: 很快，你就會看清我們需要走的路了。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Until then, I'll be here to discover more candidates just like you.
scripts.translation: 在那之前，我會留在這裡發掘更多像你一樣的候選人。

scripts.text: Are you the one who wants to be a Rune Knight? There have been so many today.
scripts.translation: 你是想成為盧恩騎士的人嗎？今天來的人可真多啊。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: It's too bad that there haven't been many candidates that have made it to my part of the test yet so I'm just taking a bit of a rest.
scripts.translation: 很遺憾，能走到我這一關的候選人並不多，所以我正稍微休息一下。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: If you are taking the Rune Knight test I hope that you try your best. This won't be as easy to pass as Lunarea's test ok?
scripts.translation: 如果你正在參加盧恩騎士的考驗，我希望你能全力以赴。這可比露娜蕾雅的考驗難多了，明白嗎？

scripts.text: Finally! Is it my turn? I'm so happy.
scripts.translation: 終於！輪到我了？我好開心。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: There have been so many candidates failing Lunarea's test that I've given up counting.
scripts.translation: 在露娜蕾雅的考驗中失敗的人太多了，我連數都懶得數了。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: I am Renoa. I am in charge of the teaching and testing of runes and magic for Rune Knight candidates.
scripts.translation: 我是雷諾阿。我負責盧恩騎士候選人的符文與魔法教學及考核。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Thank you for all of your trouble taking the test so far. Okay, anyway.
scripts.translation: 感謝你一路堅持參加考驗。好了，言歸正傳。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Well first, I'll give you an assignment. Let's start by studying. Go to the library and study these books.
scripts.translation: 首先，我會給你佈置一個任務。讓我們

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Umm, ^0000FFRunes and Rune Knights^000000, ^0000FFThe Principles of Runes^000000, ^0000FFThe Making and use of Runes^000000. Start with these 3...
scripts.translation: 嗯，符文與盧恩騎士、符文原理、符文的製作與使用。先從這三本開始... ^0000FF^000000^0000FF^000000^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Read the book thoroughly and come back. If you are the type of person who doesn't like reading and studying then it won't be easy for you to live as a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 仔細讀完再回來。要是不喜歡看書學習，今後當盧恩騎士可有你受的。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Don't worry, you won't be required to have the same knowledge as the magicians of Geffen or Juno. But you can't be an idiot either.
scripts.translation: 別擔心，我不要求你擁有吉芬或朱諾魔法師那樣的知識。但你也絕不能是個傻瓜。

scripts.text: Well first, I'll give you an assignment. Let's start by studying. Go to the library and study these books.
scripts.translation: 從學習開始吧。去圖書館研讀這些書。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Umm, ^0000FFRunes and Rune Knights^000000, ^0000FFThe Principles of Runes^000000, ^0000FFThe Making and use of Runes^000000. Start with these 3...
scripts.translation: 嗯，符文與盧恩騎士、符文原理、符文的製作與使用。先從這三本開始... ^0000FF^000000^0000FF^000000^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Read the book thoroughly and come back. If you are the type of person who doesn't like reading and studying then it won't be easy for you to live as a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 仔細讀完再回來。要是不喜歡看書學習，今後當盧恩騎士可有你受的。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Don't worry, you won't be required to have the same knowledge as the magicians of Geffen or Juno. But you can't be an idiot either.
scripts.translation: 別擔心，我不要求你擁有吉芬或朱諾魔法師那樣的知識。但你也絕不能是個傻瓜。

scripts.text: Have you read all the books from the library? It won't be easy to read but if you are determined to be a Rune Knight, you have to have this kind of basic knowledge.
scripts.translation: 你把圖書館的書都讀完了嗎？雖然讀起來不容易，但如果你決心成為盧恩騎士，就必須具備這些基礎知識。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Basically, the power of magic cannot be used without training to draw out the power of nature and the elements.
scripts.translation: 基本上，如果不經過訓練來引導自然和元素的力量，就無法使用魔法的力量。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Therefore, jobs such as Wizard and Sage have come out and the magic became their own sacred field.
scripts.translation: 因此，巫師和賢者這樣的職業應運而生，魔法成為了他們神聖的領域。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: The leader of the Rune Knights, Beljeve, is known to have been in touch with the fairies even before the dimensional door of the Ash-Vacuum was made when Satan Morocc resurrected.
scripts.translation: 盧恩騎士的首領貝爾傑夫，據稱在魔王夢羅克復活、異世界的異次元之門建立之前，就已經與精靈們有過接觸。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: I heard a story from the magical scholars about the technology that can substantialize the essence of magic. I began a study to substantialize it to a rune by getting their help.
scripts.translation: 我從魔法學者那裡得知，有種技術能將魔力的本質化為實體。在他們的幫助下，我開始研究如何將魔力凝聚成符文。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Our Rune Knight's were born from the result of that study, which enables practicing both the power of the sword and magic by using runes.
scripts.translation: 我們的盧恩騎士正是這項研究的結果，通過符文，我們得以同時施展劍術和魔法的力量。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: You look like you don't understand why I'm repeating the teaching of the story already written in the book.
scripts.translation: 看你的樣子，似乎不明白我為什麼要重複書中已經寫好的故事。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: So for the second test, you need to visit the Laphine magical scholars who had given the direct help to the birth of Rune Knights at Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation: 所以，作為第二個測試，你需要去拜訪那些在異世界直接幫助盧恩騎士誕生的拉菲尼魔法學者。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Find the sage, Serpeone who's been studying and helping the Rune Knights who are out in the Midgard's camp at Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation: 去異世界的米德加爾特營地，找賢者塞爾佩奧內。她一直致力於符文研究，協助我們盧恩騎士。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: The sage has already been in touch with us for a long time so you don't need to worry about understanding Serpeone's language.
scripts.translation: 這位賢者已經與我們長期保持聯絡，所以你不用擔心聽不懂塞爾佩奧內的語言。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: If you are ready I'll guide you to the warp that moves you directly to Serpeone. Meet her and get instructions from her.
scripts.translation: 如果你準備好了，我會指引你前往能直接傳送到塞爾佩奧內那裡的傳送點。去見她，並聽從她的指示。

scripts.text: If you are ready I'll open the way to the sage, Serpeone who's in the Midgard post at Ash-Vacuum. Are you prepared?
scripts.translation: 準備好了的話，我就送你去見異世界米德加爾特營地的賢者塞爾佩奧內。可以出發了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I am prepared.
scripts.translation: 是的，我準備好了

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 還沒有準備好

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Good. Then I'll send you there now. But, there's one thing I need to tell you.
scripts.translation: 很好。那麼我現在就送你過去。不過，有一件事我需要告訴你。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: You will be sent to the Ash-Vacuum. The people dispatched to the Midgard post are certified adventurers and officials.
scripts.translation: 你將被傳送到異世界。被派遣到米德加爾特據點的人都是經過認證的冒險者和官員。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Beljeve has an agreement with the other alliance countries that the free behavior of our Rune Knights is guaranteed but...
scripts.translation: 貝爾傑夫與其他盟國達成協議，保證我們盧恩騎士的自由行動，但是...

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: If you want to move freely through all of Ash-Vacuum, you'll have to go through the normal route which is acquiring qualification with the Midgard alliance. It has nothing to do with us.
scripts.translation: 如果你想自由探索整個異世界，就必須按正常流程，取得米德加爾特同盟的許可。這不在我們的職責範圍內。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: The agreement only allows us to send candidates to the Midgard camp and nowhere else.
scripts.translation: 該協議只允許我們將候選人送往米德加爾特營地，而不能去其他地方。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Good luck.
scripts.translation: 祝你好運。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: If you are ready talk to me again. I'm free anytime.
scripts.translation: 如果你準備好了，再跟我說話。我隨時都有空。

scripts.text: Umm, you're back? How's it like in the Ash-Vacuum?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你回來了？異世界那邊怎麼樣？

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Well, a person of your strength must have been there already no?
scripts.translation: 嗯，像你這樣實力的人，肯定已經去過那裡了吧？

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Now it's time to take the test concerning runes. I know that you have been through quite a complicated process.
scripts.translation: 現在該進行關於符文的測試了。我知道你經歷了一個相當複雜的過程。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: I am going to give you a test that allows you to deal with runes directly.
scripts.translation: 接下來的測試，要讓你親手運算子文。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: In this test you will be making a rune stone yourself which will also be used for your last test.
scripts.translation: 在這項測試中，你將親手製作符文石，它也將用於你最後的測試。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: If you remember what you read in the library just before, you'll be able to produce a rune stone here without my explanation.
scripts.translation: 如果你還記得剛才在圖書館讀到的內容，你就不需要我的解釋，也能在這裡製作符文石。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: If you succeed in making the rune stone it will automatically become the rune stone you'll use for yourself when you become a Rune Knight, so try your best.
scripts.translation: 如果你成功製作了符文石，它會自動成為你成為盧恩騎士後使用的符文石，所以請盡力而為。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: The total number of rune stones you need to make is 20.
scripts.translation: 你需要製作的符文石總數是20個。請

scripts.text: Remember that well.
scripts.translation: 牢記這一點。

scripts.text: In this test you will be making a rune stone yourself which is going to be used for your last test.
scripts.translation: 在這次考驗中，你需要親手製作一塊符文石，它將用於你的最終考驗。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: If you remember the books you've read in the library just before, you'll be able to produce a rune stone here without my explanation.
scripts.translation: 如果你還記得剛才在圖書館讀過的書，你就不需要我的解釋，也能在這裡製作符文石。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: If you succeed in making the rune stone automatically it becomes the rune stone you'll use for yourself when you succeed, and it's delivered to Captain Tigris...so try hard.
scripts.translation: 如果你成功製作了符文石，它會自動成為你成功晉升後使用的符文石，並交付給隊長 提格里斯...所以請加油。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: The number of total rune stones you need to make is exactly 20. Remember that well.
scripts.translation: 你需要製作的符文石總數正好是20個。請牢記這一點。

scripts.text: Check number of made runes?
scripts.translation: 檢視已製作的符文數量

scripts.text: I've made all the 20 rune stones.
scripts.translation: 我已經制作了全部20個符文石

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: The number of rune stones made 'til now is {0}.
scripts.translation: 目前為止製作的符文石數量是。 {0}

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Hey! I think I told you to make at least 20.
scripts.translation: 嘿！我想我告訴過你要製作至少20個。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: You've brought just the right amount. I'll hand over all the finished rune stones to Captain Tigris.
scripts.translation: 你帶來的數量正好。我會把所有完成的符文石交給隊長 提格里斯。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Wow! What's this? You've made over 20. It's ok for now but remember to follow directions next time.
scripts.translation: 哇！這是什麼？你製作了超過20個。現在沒關係，但下次請記得遵循指示。

scripts.text: I'll hand over all the made rune stones to Captain Tigris.
scripts.translation: 我會把所有制作的符文石交給隊長 提格里斯。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Because there is a test waiting for you that uses these rune stones.
scripts.translation: 因為有一項使用這些符文石的測試在等著你。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Here, you've passed. Go back to Captain Tigris and complete the next test.
scripts.translation: 好了，你通過了。回到隊長 提格里斯那裡，完成下一項測試。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight, Renoa]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 雷諾阿]

scripts.text: Ha! You did a good job considering how difficult my test is. If you were nervous, you can relax now.
scripts.translation: 哈！考慮到我的測試有多難，你做得很好。如果你感到緊張，現在可以放鬆了。

scripts.text: Become a proud Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 成為自豪的盧恩騎士。

scripts.text: How... how did you get in here?! Captain, we have a spy!
scripts.translation: 你...你怎麼進來的？！隊長，有間諜！

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: The birth of Rune Knights
scripts.translation: 盧恩騎士的誕生

scripts.text: Runes and Magic Energy
scripts.translation: 符文與魔力

scripts.text: Stop Reading

scripts.text: Rune Knights are the gathering of evolved swordmen who have achieved the harmony of sword and magic.
scripts.translation: 盧恩騎士是超越自身極限、將劍術與魔法融會貫通的劍士群體。

scripts.text: It had been achieved by the legendary swordsman Beljeve who's been known as a Sword Master and a founder of dispensable expenditure.
scripts.translation: 這一成就由傳奇劍士貝爾傑夫達成，他被譽為劍術大師，也是符文消耗理論的奠基人。

scripts.text: Rune Knights use rune stones as a medium for magic power rather than using the magical energy made directly within the body.
scripts.translation: 盧恩騎士使用符文石作為魔力的媒介，而不是直接使用體內產生的魔力。

scripts.text: Magic power could only previously be used by those who can harness magic power within their bodies through a long time of research
scripts.translation: 過去，只有那些通過長期研究能在體內駕馭魔力的人才能使用魔力。

scripts.text: However, for the direct research on the rune magical power which had broken the human's normal concept is now ongoing.
scripts.translation: 如今，對符文魔力的研究仍在進行。這種力量，打破了人類以往的認知。

scripts.text: It's known that the Sword Master Beljeve felt the limit of his power, so he studied the way to overcome the physical limitation of mortals.
scripts.translation: 據記載，劍術大師貝爾傑夫感受到了自身力量的極限，因此他開始研究如何突破凡人的肉體限制。

scripts.text: We guess he had been already in touch with the Laphine tribe long before the dimensional rift was discovered to get to the Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation: 我們推測，早在發現通往異世界的次元裂縫之前，他就已經與拉菲尼族有了接觸。

scripts.text: The Laphine tribe are the fairies from the Ash-Vacuum and are known to have a close relationship to the birth of the Rune Knights.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族是來自異世界的精靈，它們與盧恩騎士的誕生有著密切的關係。

scripts.text: Now it's possible for those who are normally unsuited to using magic power to carry a medium that can carry magic that normal mortals could not wield before.
scripts.translation: 如今，那些原本不適合使用魔力的人，也可以通過承載魔力的媒介，施展出普通凡人無法駕馭的力量。

scripts.text: The result of studying these techniques are the rune stones tuned in harmony with the physical power of swords.
scripts.translation: 研究這些技術的成果，便是能與劍的物理力量和諧共鳴的符文石。

scripts.text: Beljeve's disciples who started to learn the way to imbue their swords with rune stones became known as Rune Knights.
scripts.translation: 貝爾傑夫的弟子們開始學習藉助符文石為劍注入魔力，他們便是後來的盧恩騎士。

scripts.text: A jewel called as a Rune is a medium that contains the formless existence, the magical power and the essence of it can be used directly.
scripts.translation: 符文是一種寶石，能夠容納無形的魔力，並讓人直接運用其中的力量。

scripts.text: The Laphine Sage, Serpeone and the founder of Rune Knights Beljeve co-researched runes and the result of their research has only recently become to be known to the world.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族的賢者塞爾佩奧內與盧恩騎士的創始人貝爾傑夫共同研究了符文，他們的研究成果直到最近才為世人所知。

scripts.text: It's a limitless alternative energy source and research on them is still ongoing.
scripts.translation: 這是一種無限的替代能源，目前對它的研究仍在進行中。

scripts.text: Unlike humans, the living things in the Ash-Vacuum preserve magical energy by holding it in their bodies.
scripts.translation: 與人類不同，異世界的生物能夠將魔力儲存於體內。

scripts.text: The discovery of transferring this magical power into runes was refined by Beljeve and Serpeone and shared with the Rune Knights.
scripts.translation: 貝爾傑夫與塞爾佩奧內完善了將這種魔力轉入符文的技術，並傳授給盧恩騎士。

scripts.text: The principle use of Runes
scripts.translation: 符文的主要用途

scripts.text: The types of Runes
scripts.translation: 符文的種類

scripts.text: Stop Reading
scripts.translation: 停止閱讀

scripts.text: A rune is a kind of symbol that's been used on the Midgard continent since ancient times. Up until now it has only been used by occult circles.
scripts.translation: 符文是一種自遠古時代起就在米德加爾特大陸使用的符號。直到現在，它主要只被神秘學圈子所使用。

scripts.text: Runes are used as a symbol system, however, by the story handed down orally, it's known to be used for fortune-telling or used to draw out the human sub consciousness.
scripts.translation: 雖然符文被用作一種符號系統，但根據口耳相傳的故事，它也被用於占卜或挖掘人類的潛意識。

scripts.text: Runes have their own system and types and can draw out various powers according to how they are arranged. But their power level can't currently be measured by known means.
scripts.translation: 符文擁有自己的體系和種類，根據其排列方式可以激發出不同的力量。但目前尚無法用已知手段測量其力量等級。

scripts.text: It is fortunate that the Rune Knights discovered their use for positive means. Runes have not been used for dark magic but it is certainly possible for their power to be misused if in the wrong hands.
scripts.translation: 幸運的是，盧恩騎士發現了符文的正面用途。雖然符文未被用於黑暗魔法，但如果落入壞人之手，其力量確實有可能被濫用。

scripts.text: The runes are created from a a total of 25 small stones and they are very fragile to physical shock. So they require special care when being handled.
scripts.translation: 符文由25種小石頭構成，很容易因外力衝擊而受損，因此處理時必須格外小心。

scripts.text: The 25 stones have different meanings and among these, 14 when counter-positioned can have entirely different power and meaning from the original so it's essential to study the exceptional aspects.
scripts.translation: 這25種石頭各有含義。其中14種在逆位時，力量與含義會與正位截然不同，因此必須學會辨別。

scripts.text: The other 11 runes have consistent power, not influenced by any position so if you don't master all 11 ordinary runes and the 14 inverse runes, you cannot draw out all the complete power.
scripts.translation: 其餘11種符文的力量不受正逆位置影響。因此，只有掌握這11種常規符文和14種可逆位符文，才能充分發揮它們的力量。

scripts.text: Among the 11 ordinary runes, the blank rune is an exception.
scripts.translation: 在11顆普通符文之中，空白符文是一個例外。

scripts.text: The names of the 25 rune stones are the following:
scripts.translation: 25顆符文石的名字如下：

scripts.text: The making of Rune stones is achieved through a skill called rune mastery which is learned when one becomes a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 符文石的製造是通過一種名為符文精熟的技能實現的，該技能在成為盧恩騎士時習得。

scripts.text: Rune Mastery is like a code that's been put into the body as a mark of a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 符文精熟如同銘刻在體內的密文，是盧恩騎士身份的印記。

scripts.text: Ordinary people can also learn this skill and it needs its own machine called a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 普通人也可以學習這項技能，但需要使用一種名為符文熔爐的機器。

scripts.text: When you making a Rune stone with a Rune Furnace, the type of rune is determined by the magical energy put into it, and it cannot be changed.
scripts.translation: 使用符文熔爐製造符文石時，符文的種類由注入的魔法能量決定，且無法更改。

scripts.text: When making a rune stone by using Rune Mastery, it can be made into the rune property that you want but it's classified as a Rune Knights' own ability.
scripts.translation: 使用符文精熟製造符文石時，可以製成想要的符文屬性，但這被歸類為盧恩騎士的專屬能力。

scripts.text: When you operate the Rune Furnace, the magical energy of the body gets concentrated through it and it enables the change into a Rune Stone.
scripts.translation: 運算子文熔爐時，體內的魔法能量會經由熔爐聚集，從而轉化為符文石。
