scripts.text: Ehwaz - This rune means the enhancement of luck and positive power. It shapes the source in the form of a red spiral in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 艾瓦茲（Ehwaz）——這顆符文意味著幸運和正面力量的增強。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為紅色的螺旋形狀。

scripts.text: Osilia - This rune is an equivalent exchange which means that you lose one and you gain one, and it also means the power that needs a cost. This is shaped into the form of a violet oblique line in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 奧西利亞（Osilia）——這顆符文意味著等價交換，即失去一樣並獲得一樣，也意味著需要付出代價的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為紫色的斜線形狀。

scripts.text: Mannaz - This rune means hope and a new start and also the positive power that can reverse a desperate situation. This is shaped into the form of an emerald diamond in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 曼納茲（Mannaz）——這顆符文意味著希望和新開始，以及能夠逆轉絕境的正向力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為翠綠色的菱形。

scripts.text: Ansuz - This rune means preparation or arrangement and the power that can overcome the uneasiness of the coming future. This is shaped into the form of an emerald round in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 安蘇茲（Ansuz）——這顆符文意味著準備或安排，以及能夠克服對未來不安的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為翠綠色的圓形。

scripts.text: Hagalas - This rune means the freedom and the power that resists restraint. This is shaped into the form of a sky-blue colored star-shape in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 哈卡拉茲（Hagalas）——這顆符文意味著自由，以及抵抗束縛的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為天藍色的星形。

scripts.text: Kano - This rune means flame and passion, and the power that ends everything. The source of it is shaped into the form of a red diamond in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 卡諾（Kano）——這顆符文意味著火焰與激情，以及終結一切的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為紅色的菱形。

scripts.text: Rhydo - This rune means the combination and recombination and the power of completion. This is shaped into the sky-blue oblique line in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 萊德赫（Rhydo）——這顆符文意味著結合與重組，以及完成的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為天藍色的斜線。

scripts.text: Turisus - This rune means the border and the power of limitation. This is shaped into a yellow round in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 突裡薩茲（Turisus）——這顆符文意味著邊界與限制的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為黃色的圓形。

scripts.text: Dagaz - This rune means the talent and the power of enduring adversity. This is shaped into an emerald spiral in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 達加茲（Dagaz）——這顆符文意味著天賦與逆境中堅持的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為翠綠色的螺旋。

scripts.text: Sowilo - This rune means victory and success and the power of arrangement and cessation. This is shaped into the form of a sky-blue fan-shape in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 索維洛（Sowilo）——這顆符文意味著勝利與成功，以及秩序與停止的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為天藍色的扇形。

scripts.text: Laguz -This rune means uncertainty and the power that protects the inside. This is shaped into a form of a yellow diamond in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 拉古茲（Laguz）——這顆符文意味著不確定性，以及保護內部的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為黃色的菱形。

scripts.text: Isia - This rune means the power that stops everything. This is shaped into a violet spiral in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 伊札（Isia）——這顆符文意味著停止一切的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為紫色的螺旋。

scripts.text: Pertz - This rune means revelation and the power of chance. This is shaped into the form of silver spiral in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 培爾多羅（Pertz）——這顆符文意味著啟示與機遇的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為銀色的螺旋。

scripts.text: Verkana - This rune means richness, birth and the power of defense and protection. This is shaped into the form of a gold-color star in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 貝爾卡諾（Verkana）——這顆符文意味著富足、誕生，以及防禦與保護的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為金色的星形。

scripts.text: Gebo - This rune means cooperation and the power of harmony. This is shaped into the form of a yellow cone in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 蓋博（Gebo）——這顆符文意味著合作與和諧的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為黃色的錐形。

scripts.text: Algiz - This rune means chance and the power of challenge. This is shaped into the form of an emerald oblique line in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 阿爾吉茲（Algiz）——這顆符文意味著機遇與挑戰的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為翠綠色的斜線。

scripts.text: Arwez - This rune means change, convulsion and the power of movement. This is shaped into the form of a gray diamond in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 阿爾維茲（Arwez）——這顆符文意味著變化、動盪與運動的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為灰色的菱形。

scripts.text: Teiwaz - This rune means perfect victory and the power of absolute solution. This is shaped into the form of a gold round in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 泰瓦茲（Teiwaz）——這顆符文象徵徹底的勝利，以及解決一切的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為金色的圓形。

scripts.text: Wunjo - This rune means intelligence and the power of wisdom. This is shaped into the form of an emerald star in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 溫喬（Wunjo）——這顆符文象徵才智與智慧的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為翠綠色的星形。

scripts.text: Jera - This rune means comfort and the power of rest. This is shaped into the form of a yellow round in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 耶拉（Jera）——這顆符文意味著舒適與休息的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為黃色的圓形。

scripts.text: Nosiege - This rune means weakness and the power of attenuating. This is shaped into the form of a yellow fan-shape in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 那特席茲（Nosiege）——這顆符文意味著虛弱與衰減的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為黃色的扇形。

scripts.text: Ingz - This rune means disruption and the power of separation. This is shaped into the form of a violet diamond in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 英格茲（Ingz）——這顆符文意味著破壞與分離的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為紫色的菱形。

scripts.text: Fehu - This rune means attainment and the power of materialization. This is shaped into the form of a silver round in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 費胡（Fehu）——這顆符文意味著獲得與具現化的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為銀色的圓形。

scripts.text: Urj - This rune means destiny and the power of restriction. This is shaped into the form of a violet spiral line in a Rune Furnace.
scripts.translation: 烏魯茲（Urj）——這顆符文意味著命運與限制的力量。在符文熔爐中，它呈現為紫色的螺旋線。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Sage Guard]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 賢者衛兵]

scripts.text: The sage Serpeone is the one who has been with us since the beginning of the Rune Knights.
scripts.translation: 賢者塞爾佩奧內是盧恩騎士創立之初便與我們同在的人。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Sage Guard]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 賢者衛兵]

scripts.text: I am very proud as a Rune Knight to serve beside her.
scripts.translation: 能作為盧恩騎士在她身邊效力，我感到非常自豪。

scripts.text: You might be walking the way of the sword but you are not a Rune Knight yet. Don't wander around here too much if you know what I mean.
scripts.translation: 你或許在追尋劍之道，但你還不是盧恩騎士。如果你明白我的意思，就別在這裡到處亂逛了。

scripts.text: Splendide is the land of the Laphine. We are offering a convenience by an agreement between the Rune Knights and the expeditionary team.
scripts.translation: 輝煌領域是拉菲尼的土地。根據盧恩騎士與遠征隊之間的協議，我們提供這項便利服務。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Sage Guard]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 賢者衛兵]

scripts.text: Our agents are opening the way to Splendide only for the trainees who are taking the Rune Knight job change test.
scripts.translation: 駐守的騎士只為參加轉職測試的學員開放通往輝煌領域的道路。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Sage Guard]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 賢者衛兵]

scripts.text: But when you become a Rune Knight, you'll need to make sure that you join the expeditionary team in order to fully explore the Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation: 但當你成為盧恩騎士後，為了完全探索異世界，你必須加入遠征隊。

scripts.text: Hanging around this man won't be good for you. Keep going the way you were heading.
scripts.translation: 和這個人混在一起對你沒好處。繼續沿著你原本的方向走吧。

scripts.text: [Dispatched Rune Knight]
scripts.translation: [派遣的盧恩騎士]

scripts.text: Thanks for your work. We will continue our mission for the Rune Knight testers.
scripts.translation: 辛苦了。我們會繼續在這裡，為參加盧恩騎士測試的人提供協助。

scripts.text: I've been waiting for you Rune Knight candidate. I'm helping the candidates as a favor to Ms. Serpeone.
scripts.translation: 等你很久了，盧恩騎士候選人。我受塞爾佩奧內女士所託，在這裡協助各位候選人。

scripts.text: [Dispatched Rune Knight]
scripts.translation: [派遣的盧恩騎士]

scripts.text: Do you want to go out to the Splendide field?
scripts.translation: 你想去輝煌領域野外嗎？

scripts.text: Move to Splendide field
scripts.translation: 前往輝煌領域野外

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Do you want to go back to the expeditionary team's post?
scripts.translation: 你想回到遠征隊的據點嗎？

scripts.text: Yes please.
scripts.translation: 是的，請送我回去

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 還沒有準備好

scripts.text: Shh... Our mission is not something to be revealed to the public. Please just move along.
scripts.translation: 噓...我們的任務不能向公眾透露。請繼續趕路吧。

scripts.text: - Whispers of the sage Serpeone are delivered to my mind. -
scripts.translation: - 賢者塞爾佩奧內的低語傳入我的腦海。-

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Until you become an honorable Rune Knight I cannot help you control your powers in Midgard.
scripts.translation: 在你成為光榮的盧恩騎士之前，我無法幫助你在米德加爾特控制你的力量。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Please understand this and be devoted to this test.
scripts.translation: 請理解這一點，並專心投入這場考試。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Finally you are an honorable Rune Knight. I'm happy to help you.
scripts.translation: 終於，你成為了光榮的盧恩騎士。我很樂意幫助你。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: The power of Runes are not perfect and more research still needs to be done to make it perfectly safe. It is up to me and other Rune Knights like you to make sure to continue that research.
scripts.translation: 符文的力量尚不完善，要確保安全，還得繼續研究。這就要靠我，以及像你這樣的盧恩騎士共同努力了。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Please be devoted to the Runes and hopefully your life will be illuminated by it.
scripts.translation: 請全心全意地奉獻給符文，願你的生命因此得到照亮。

scripts.text: It must be surprising that I, a Laphine, am here in your people's base.
scripts.translation: 我作為拉菲尼人，出現在你們人類

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Some of us have been in contact with humans in special situations since even before the dimensional rift opened up.
scripts.translation: 早在次元裂縫出現之前，我們中的一些人就已經在特殊情況下與人類建立了聯絡。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: I have been having correspondences with humans for a number of years now. It was for mutual interests. Anyway, that's how I learned your language.
scripts.translation: 我已經與人類通訊好幾年了。那是出於共同的利益。總之，我就是這樣學會了你們的語言的。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Maybe there needs to be a machine that can translate the Laphine language to make it easier for humans to understand us.
scripts.translation: 也許我們需要一臺機器來翻譯拉菲尼語，這樣人類就能更容易地理解我們了。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: More than that... I cannot tell you more. I cannot speak carelessly since I'm speaking for my people here and I am on a special pass to be allowed in your camp.
scripts.translation: 除此之外...我不能透露更多。既然我是代表我的族人說話，而且我是持特別通行證進入你們營地的，所以我不能隨意發言。

scripts.text: Welcome, you are the one taking the job training test of the Rune Knights. I am Serpeone.
scripts.translation: 歡迎，你就是參加盧恩騎士轉職測試的人吧。我是塞爾佩奧內。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: All Rune Knights that you've met so far are the disciples who were taught by me and Beljeve. Now you are on your way to joining them.
scripts.translation: 你之前遇到的所有盧恩騎士，都是由我和貝爾傑夫教導的弟子。現在，你也即將加入他們的行列。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: I think you've already heard a basic explanation and instructions from Renoa. Now it seems that it's my turn to help you out.
scripts.translation: 我想你已經從雷諾阿那裡聽到了基本的說明和指導。現在，輪到我來幫助你了。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: The magical power that the Rune Knights use are not technically the same as the magical power made in the human world.
scripts.translation: 嚴格來說，盧恩騎士使用的魔力，與人類世界產生的魔力並不相同。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Right this place... our sphere where you call as Ash-Vacuum...it's the magical power made with
scripts.translation: 它來自這裡...來自我們這個被你們稱作“異世界”的領域...

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: The living things in this place have been preserving the magical energy in our bodies unlike the living things in the human world.
scripts.translation: 這裡的生物與人類世界的生物不同，它們一直在體內儲存著魔法能量。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: The power of the rune stones is the way of shaping the magical power in our bodies into runes which take place of our bodies as a medium.
scripts.translation: 符文石，就是把我們體內的魔力凝聚成符文，讓符文代替身體，成為承載魔力的媒介。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: So to use the rune stone you need a direct understanding of the other sphere's living things.
scripts.translation: 所以，要使用符文石，你得親自了解異世界的生物。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: But, it must be too much for you to extract the magical energy from the living things in this land yet.
scripts.translation: 但是，對於現在的你來說，從這片土地的生物中提取魔法能量可能還為時過早。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Now I'll cast a magic spell on your body so you can gather magic energy from other living things.
scripts.translation: 現在我要在你的身上施加一個魔法，這樣你就可以從其他生物那裡收集魔法能量了。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Temporarily you'll able to extract magic energy from evil creatures in the human world. Of course you won't be able to use the energy directly...
scripts.translation: 暫時，你將能夠從人類世界的邪惡生物中提取魔法能量。當然，你無法直接使用這種能量...

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: If you store up the energy by getting rid of evil creatures in the human world, I'll convert it to the energy that you can use.
scripts.translation: 如果你通過消滅人類世界的邪惡生物來積蓄能量，我會將其轉化為你可以使用的能量。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: The vicious souls that they keep even after being dead is the great source of magical powers.
scripts.translation: 它們死後依然保留的邪惡靈魂，是魔力的巨大源泉。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Please get rid of ^0000FF10 Dullahan^000000, ^0000FF10 Disguise^000000, ^0000FF10 Quve^000000, ^0000FF10 Heirozoist^000000 and gather their energy.
[Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: I am telling you beforehand but I don't test or judge your qualification. A Rune Knight will be the judge of that.
scripts.translation: 我先說明一下，我不負責測試或評判你的資質。那將由盧恩騎士來判定。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: If you have any problems or any questions, please talk to me.
scripts.translation: 如果你有任何問題或疑問，請隨時來找我。

scripts.text: Are you gathering enough magical energy? Or do you have any questions?
scripts.translation: 魔力收集得怎麼樣了？還有什麼疑問嗎？

scripts.text: I've gathered enough energy.
scripts.translation: 我已經收集了足夠的能量

scripts.text: To the gathering place.
scripts.translation: 前往集會地點

scripts.text: Stop the conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Is it so? Then let's check this out.
scripts.translation: 是嗎？那讓我們來看看。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Umm, this is great. Enough amount of living body magical energy has accumulated in your body.
scripts.translation: 嗯，這很不錯。你的身體裡已經積蓄了足夠多的生物魔法能量。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Rune Knight Renoa will tell you the way of using rune stones.
scripts.translation: 盧恩騎士 雷諾阿會告訴你如何使用符文石。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Now I think my part is all over. I hope you will become an honorable Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 我能幫你的就到這裡了。願你成為一名光榮的盧恩騎士。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: If you have any business here, I'll send you to the Rune Knight gathering place. If you are ready, please tell me.
scripts.translation: 如果你有事要辦，或準備好繼續測試，我可以送你回盧恩騎士的集會地點。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: You haven't collected enough magical energy yet.
scripts.translation: 你還沒有收集到足夠的魔法能量。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Please brace yourself and gather enough energy by dispatching those monsters.
scripts.translation: 請做好準備，通過消滅那些魔物來收集足夠的能量。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: You want to go back to the gathering place? If you want I'll send you back there immediately. But to continue the test you'll need to come and see me again.
scripts.translation: 你想回到集會地點嗎？如果你願意，我可以立刻送你回去。但若要繼續測試，你需要再來見我。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Do you want to go back the Rune Knight gathering place?
scripts.translation: 你想回到盧恩騎士的集會地點嗎？

scripts.text: I want to go back.
scripts.translation: 我想回去

scripts.text: I want to cancel.
scripts.translation: 我想取消

scripts.text: Are you ready to go back to the Rune Knight gathering place?
scripts.translation: 你準備好回到盧恩騎士的集會地點了嗎？

scripts.text: I want to go back now.
scripts.translation: 我想現在回去

scripts.text: I am not ready yet.
scripts.translation: 我還沒準備好

scripts.text: Are the preparations going well?
scripts.translation: 準備得怎麼樣了？

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Aren't you in the wrong state right now?
scripts.translation: 你現在的狀態不對吧？

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Then I'll send you to the Rune Knight gathering place where you should be.
scripts.translation: 那我會送你去盧恩騎士的集會地點，那裡才是你應該在的地方。

scripts.text: I'll go back now.
scripts.translation: 我現在就回去

scripts.text: I'll stay.
scripts.translation: 我要留下

scripts.text: It must be surprising that I, a Laphine, am here in your people's base.
scripts.translation: 的基地，這一定讓你感到驚訝吧。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Some of us have been in contact with humans in special situations since even before the dimensional rift opened up.
scripts.translation: 早在次元裂縫出現之前，我們中的一些人就已經在特殊情況下與人類建立了聯絡。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: I have been having correspondences with humans for a number of years now. It was for mutual interests. Anyway, that's how I learned your language.
scripts.translation: 我已經與人類通訊好幾年了。那是出於共同的利益。總之，我就是這樣學會了你們的語言的。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: Maybe there needs to be a machine that can translate the Laphine language to make it easier for humans to understand us.
scripts.translation: 也許我們需要一臺機器來翻譯拉菲尼語，這樣人類就能更容易地理解我們了。

scripts.text: [Sage Serpeone]
scripts.translation: [賢者 塞爾佩奧內]

scripts.text: More than that... I cannot tell you more. I cannot speak carelessly since I'm speaking for my people here and I am on a special pass to be allowed in your camp.
scripts.translation: 除此之外...我不能透露更多。既然我是代表我的族人說話，而且我是持特別通行證進入你們營地的，所以我不能隨意發言。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: You still smell like a fledging. Bring honor to the Rune Knights and raise your power...
scripts.translation: 你還透著一股新手氣息。繼續磨鍊實力，為盧恩騎士爭光吧...

scripts.text: A very cold feeling Rune Knight dressed in black from head to toe is scowling at me.
scripts.translation: 一個從頭到腳都穿著黑色衣服的盧恩騎士，散發著冰冷的氣息，正皺著眉頭看著我。

scripts.text: Why are all of the Rune Knights blabberers or uncommunicative and combative...?
scripts.translation: 為什麼盧恩騎士們要麼喋喋不休，要麼沉默寡言且好鬥...

scripts.text: [Captain Tigris]
scripts.translation: [隊長 提格里斯]

scripts.text: Hey... What about me? I'm not like that!
scripts.translation: 嘿...我呢？我不像那樣！

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: I didn't think that a candidate would make it to me today...
scripts.translation: 沒想到今天會有候選人來到我面前...

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: Congratulations! You are at the long-waited final test... I think you've mastered the basics now.
scripts.translation: 恭喜！你終於迎來了期待已久的最終測試...我想你已經掌握了基礎。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: The final test is relatively simple. Everything ends when you get rid of all the magical monsters in this Glast Heim...
scripts.translation: 最終測試相對簡單。只要清除葛拉斯特海姆所有的魔法魔物，一切就結束了...

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: The only condition is that you have to get rid of these monsters by using the rune stones you made at the former test.
scripts.translation: 唯一的條件是，你必須使用在上一輪測試中製作的符文石來消滅這些魔物。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: For this test, only a one-hand weapon, a shield or a two-handed weapon can be equipped.
scripts.translation: 在本次測試中，只能裝備單手武器、盾牌或雙手武器。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: The only set of weapons you can use should be within the weight limit of 400. Rune stones to be provided are 30 attack-only rune stones and 30 defense-only rune stones.
scripts.translation: 只能攜帶一套武器，總重量不得超過400。我們會提供30顆攻擊專用符文石和30顆防禦專用符文石。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: To use these runes, I will cast a special buff spell over you.
scripts.translation: 為了使用這些符文，我將對你施加一個特殊的增益魔法。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: The magical monsters are the 3 kinds of magic monsters from Glast Heim that you might already know... It won't be an easy fight but if you just undergo this final suffering, you'll walk the path of a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 對手是葛拉斯特海姆的3種魔物，你或許已經見過它們...戰鬥不會輕鬆，但只要熬過這最後的試煉，你就能成為盧恩騎士。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: To help the preparation we've made a contract with the Kafra headquarters in Al De Baran by employing a Kafra Employee especially for this gathering place. So it would be good to visit her.
scripts.translation: 為了協助準備，我們與艾爾帕蘭的卡普拉總部簽訂了契約，專門為此集會地點僱用了一名卡普拉職員。所以最好去拜訪她。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: If you are ready just talk to me again.
scripts.translation: 如果你準備好了，就再來找我。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: If all of your preparations are done, I'll send you to the final test field.
scripts.translation: 如果你已經做好了所有準備，我會送你去最終測試場地。

scripts.text: Enter the final test field.
scripts.translation: 進入最終測試場地

scripts.text: I'm not ready yet.
scripts.translation: 我還沒準備好

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: For this test, only a one-hand weapon, a shield or a two-handed weapon can be equipped. Keep your other equipments with the Kafra Employee in the center.
scripts.translation: 在本次測試中，只能裝備單手武器、盾牌或雙手武器。請將其他裝備寄存在中央的卡普拉職員處。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: Haven't you failed at the test... If you fail once, you cannot enter again for 10 minutes.
scripts.translation: 你剛才失敗了吧...測試失敗後，要等10分鐘才能再次進入。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: It's a consideration for the other testers who are waiting for the test, just like you, so come back after the designated time.
scripts.translation: 這是為了體諒像你一樣正在等待測試的其他考生，請在指定時間後再回來。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: The only set of weapons you can use should be within the weight limit of 400. Rune stones to be provided are 30 attack-only rune stones and 30 defense-only rune stones.
scripts.translation: 只能攜帶一套武器，總重量不得超過400。我們會提供30顆攻擊專用符文石和30顆防禦專用符文石。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: The remaining stuff you are holding should be kept by the Kafra employee in the middle.
scripts.translation: 你手中剩下的物品，請寄存在中間的卡普拉職員處。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: Looks like there is already an applicant in the test room.
scripts.translation: 看起來測試房間裡已經有考生了。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: Be patient and wait your turn.
scripts.translation: 請耐心等待，輪到你時再進去。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: Wait, I'll collect all the rune stones provided before. There's a certain limit on using the rune stones that's made for the test.
scripts.translation: 等等，我要先回收之前發放的所有符文石。用於測試的符文石使用數量是有限制的。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: I'll get new rune stones so if your preparation is all done, please talk to me again.
scripts.translation: 我會準備新的符文石。如果你已經做好了所有準備，請再次與我對話。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: You've been very successful up to the last test.
scripts.translation: 直到最後一項測試，你都表現得非常出色。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: Now all the tests you need to take are over. Go back to Captain Tigris and inform him of this test result, and then feel the deep emotion of being born again as a Rune Knight.
scripts.translation: 所有測試都結束了。去向提格里斯隊長報告結果吧，好好體會成為盧恩騎士、迎來新生的感動。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: Congratulations!
scripts.translation: 恭喜你！

scripts.text: Well I'd better go now for the remaining candidates.
scripts.translation: 好了，我得去接待剩下的考生了。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: Wait, I'll collect all the rune stones provided before. There's a certain limit on using the rune stones that's made for the test.
scripts.translation: 等等，我要先回收之前發放的所有符文石。用於測試的符文石使用數量是有限制的。

scripts.text: [Rune Knight Velpino]
scripts.translation: [盧恩騎士 維爾皮諾]

scripts.text: I'll need to re-use these unused rune stones. Talk to me again once I have taken all the test rune stones.
scripts.translation: 我需要重新利用這些未使用的符文石。等我回收完所有測試符文石後，請再次與我對話。

scripts.text: A very cold feeling Rune Knight dressed in black from head to toe is scowling at me.
scripts.translation: 一個從頭到腳都穿著黑色衣服的盧恩騎士，散發著冰冷的氣息，正皺著眉頭看著我。

scripts.text: Enter the Password.
scripts.translation: 請輸入密碼。

scripts.translation: 盧恩騎士轉職管理模組啟動

scripts.translation: 當前盧恩騎士測試場地數量為...。 {0}

scripts.translation: 盧恩騎士轉職全域性變數已修改為 0。現在可以使用測試場地。
